不必把每一刻都填满。留白让我们重新听见自己的想法。: You don't have to fill every moment. A little space lets you hear your own thoughts again.
不用等到准备完美，先把第一句话写下来。: Don't wait until you're ready. Write the first sentence.
给生活留一点空白: Leave a little room in your day
给自己一杯茶的时间: Take time for a cup of tea
换一条路回家，也许会发现被忽略的美好。: Take a different way home and notice what you might have missed.
让片刻的停顿，成为一天温柔的注脚。: Let a quiet pause be a gentle footnote to your day.
试着在一天里留下一段不被安排的时间。散步、发呆，或者只是看一会儿窗外，灵感常常就: Leave some time in your day unplanned. Take a walk, let your mind wander, or look out the window. Inspiration often arrives in those gaps.
熟悉街道的新风景: A new view of a familiar street
写下所见，留住所感。: Write what you see. Keep what you feel.
在忙碌与安静之间，记录那些值得慢下来想一想的事。: Between busy days and quiet moments, make a note of what deserves a little more thought.
